operation_details.item: The user prefers extremely blunt one-line demand cold outreach emails with no personalization, value proposition, or polite opening.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the outbound push looking today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Busy but manageable. I’m tightening up a few cold outreach templates for the team.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Are you aiming for a consultative approach, or keeping the messages very direct?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Very direct. I prefer extremely blunt one-line demand cold outreach emails.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. What structure are you using for those one-liners?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: No personalization, no value proposition, and no polite opening—just the ask.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That’s a stark contrast to the relationship-led messaging many sales teams use.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I want the message to be short, blunt, and focused on getting a response.
